title: Trump hitting medium and heavy trucks with 25 per cent tariff on Nov. 1
summary: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump signed a proclamation Friday to slap a 25 per cent tariff on imported medium- and heavy-duty trucks beginning Nov. 1, with a carveout for vehicles traded under the Canada-U.S.-Mexico Agreement.
